name: creator-intelligence
description: Find creators, capture their public business contact, vet them with a transparent score, and research their audience and content, from public data only.

interface.longDescription: One pipeline from niche to shortlist: discover creators who bring their own audience, capture the business contact they chose to publish, vet them with gates and a confidence-labelled score, and run the social research workflows around them (outliers, comments, transcripts, competitors, ads). Public data only. Sending outreach is out of scope and is governed by the outreach-compliance skill.
defaultPrompt: Find 25 creators in the home-fitness niche who can carry a brand partnership and capture their published business contact.
Vet these ten creators: audience fit, authenticity risk, brand safety and a scored shortlist.
What do I need to check before emailing the creators in this list?
